games.name: Sea Battle
games.description: Hide your fleet, hunt theirs. Grab gifts for big missiles, missile rain and the nuke.

games.name: Tic Tac Toe
games.description: Line them up before your friend does. Quick to learn, sneaky to master.

games.name: Connect 4
games.description: Drop, stack and line up four before your rival does.

games.name: Gomoku
games.description: Fifteen lines each way, five stones to win. Build two threats, block every one of theirs.

games.name: Chess
games.description: Sixty-four squares, two armies, one king to trap. Your move.

games.name: Checkers
games.description: Hop, capture, crown a king. Leave your friend without a piece to move.

games.name: Backgammon
games.description: Roll, run and hit. Bring all fifteen checkers home and off the board first.

games.name: Chutes and Ladders
games.description: Spin, climb the ladders, slide down the chutes. First to square 100 wins.

games.name: Dots and Boxes
games.description: Join the dots, close a box and go again. Most boxes wins.

games.name: Ludo
games.description: Roll a 6 to come out, knock rivals back to their yard, and race all four tokens home.

games.name: Crazy Eights
games.description: Match the suit or the rank, play an 8 to change it, and empty your hand first. Nobody deals, nobody peeks.
